description:
Cross all four repositories to format 3 in one window: this one, mealie-fi, inflected-messages and gf2.

## Background

c47d78c8 makes the binary accept exactly format 3 (`@/inv/canonical-cutover`). An older binary and a newer one each refuse the other's repository, so install and rewrites happen together, with no sessions mid-gate. One script outside the product rewrites `index.json` to `{deleted_ids, schema_version: 3}` and drops event lines with retired tags, committed explicitly in each repository. There is no migration code. Unmerged gf2 branches are refused until they merge main; that refusal is the intended result.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: All four repositories carry the explicit rewrite commit, with `jit validate` passing before (old binary) and after (new binary), and each SHA recorded here.
- [hard] REQ-02: Before the window, the script runs on a clone at gf2's current main, each of the 20 predicted-conflict branches merged with main using the resolution rule (take main's index, union `deleted_ids`), and `jit validate` on each result with the exact-version binary. The 8 stale branches run for information. Results and script go to the invoker.
- [hard] REQ-03: gf2's owner approval is recorded before gf2 crosses.

## Notes

- 3d9a0ce3 depends on this issue, so the epic does not close until all four have crossed.
- `dev/active/9c9ac88e/subsample-repo.py` and `bench.sh` read `all_ids` and break after the rewrite.
title: Rewrite other repositories' index to format 3
